topic: Why does the next Terraform plan show changes nobody committed, and does the cluster match its manifests?
context: Terraform root module at <TF_DIR>, manifests at <MANIFEST_DIR>, kubectl context <KUBE_CONTEXT>. Lead suspects a provider upgrade and a manual console edit.
rules: Read-only: terraform plan with -lock=false and kubectl diff only; never apply, import, taint or edit state. Plan output may hold secrets, so keep it in workDir and quote only resource addresses.

streams.prompt: Run packs/infra/harness/terraform-plan-diff/run.sh. List each changed resource with its action, and for each the attribute that differs, from plan.json.
Compare the provider versions in the lock file with the versions used at the last apply, and read the provider changelogs for default changes that explain the diff.
Run packs/infra/harness/kubectl-diff/run.sh on the manifests. For each changed object say whether the cluster or the manifest is ahead, and whether a controller or operator rewrites the field.
